description: This file defines the custom exception class 'DittoHeaderInvalidException' used within a Java project. It represents an exception thrown when a header value cannot be converted to a valid Ditto header, providing builders, methods for JSON parsing, and associated documentation.

classes.name: DittoHeaderInvalidException
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating an invalid header value in Ditto API. Final class, extends DittoRuntimeException, providing static builder methods and JSON parsing capabilities.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: Inner static builder class for constructing instances of DittoHeaderInvalidException with fluent API, supporting customization of message, description, headers, cause, and hyperlink.

methods.name: newInvalidTypeBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder to generate an exception for an invalid header type, accepting header name, value, and expected type.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a DittoHeaderInvalidException instance from a JSON object and diagnostic headers.
